items.title: Dell’s AI servers drive a stellar earnings performance, and a raised outlook
items.content: The company’s backlog has reached $95 billion as demand accelerates for its AI servers

items.title: Palo Alto Networks’ stock falls despite strong AI cybersecurity demand
items.content: Enterprise cyber threats and AI adoption are giving Palo Alto Networks ‘durable tailwinds,’ according to CEO Nikesh Arora, but the stock retreated after an earnings beat

items.title: ‘I’m leaving money on the table’: I’m 64 and my husband is 70. Should I take spousal benefits or wait for my own?
items.content: “I paid a significant amount into Social Security.”

items.title: ‘It’s not fair’: My twin brother and I were left houses by our parents. Can I make him pay his share for taxes and upkeep?
items.content: “I am frustrated and financially exhausted from continuing to invest my own money into these properties.”

items.title: Dow drops below a key chart level, warning of more trouble ahead
items.content: The index last closed below its 50-day moving average on April 10, which marked the end of a correction phase that included a 5,000-point drop at its low point.

items.title: Which workers are using AI surprisingly often? Dry cleaners and construction workers.
items.content: The adoption of artificial intelligence at work has been widespread, but more “shallow” than expected — for now.

items.title: This could be the 10-year Treasury’s tipping point into the danger zone
items.content: An unrelenting rout has global bond yields touching their highest levels since 2008, driving up borrowing costs for households, businesses and world governments.

items.title: Global oil prices surge to a 6-week high after the U.S. strikes Iran in Hormuz
items.content: Oil prices on Tuesday settled at their highest levels in nearly six weeks, after the U.S. military said it struck Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz in response to Tehran’s overnight attacks on ships transiting the vital waterway.

items.title: How these homeowners pulled off buying a house in their early 20s
items.content: Despite typical first-time buyers navigating a challenging housing market in recent history, a growing number of young adults have been able to become homeowners.

items.title: ‘I feel shoehorned’: My father funded my $800,000 Roth IRA. Does that give him the right to say how I invest it?
items.content: “His argument is essentially that, since my parents provided the money for the Roth, they have a say in how I invest it.”
